stages.baseline: WASM worker already enabled, before hierarchy-preview fix
stages.fixed: One hierarchy traversal for all selected instances; before shared overlay preview and lightweight highlight lookup
stages.final: Shared overlay preview, lightweight highlight lookup and borrowed native base64. Cursor drag completed in about 3 seconds; visible active editor report 34.3 FPS. Undo observed with undo 0 and redo true.

dense_mesh.recipe: scripts/create-persistence-benchmark.py --raw; enlarge each cube by 7.5 around its 2 m grid origin, flat magenta material, edges off, camera target [100,120,0.75], distance 450, yaw -0.9, pitch 0.7, fov_y 0.7. Import as new document.
dense_mesh.result: Import, rendering, Select All, deselection and individual element selection completed. No browser console errors.
dense_mesh.limitations: Startup recording also contains earlier theater actions; generation 45 identifies the dense model. First pointer handler includes cold scene preparation. This is a candidate-only run on a different machine from the older Linux results, not a paired cold-picking speedup.
